# Security

Building, modifying, and sharing RheoBoard under its licenses is intended. There is no private embargo and no access request.

If something looks wrong in the firmware, the board, or the docs, open a public issue: https://github.com/The-Hybrid-Atelier/RheoBoard/issues

RheoBoard is not a medical or safety-critical device. See the wiki Safety page: https://github.com/The-Hybrid-Atelier/RheoBoard/wiki/Safety
